effects.name: page-load intro fade
effects.mechanism: CSS keyframe on load, staggered delays

effects.name: sticky content block
effects.mechanism: native position:sticky

effects.name: scroll vertical parallax
effects.mechanism: rAF translateY linear over viewport traversal; travel = speed×100px

effects.name: fixed action cluster appear
effects.mechanism: fixed cluster translates -40px + fades over 10–20% page scroll

effects.name: scroll-entrance reveal
effects.mechanism: IntersectionObserver + CSS transition (fade + rise)

params.distanceNote: distance approximated from fancy-text serialized setting (SECTIONS.md Table B)

effects.name: sequential stagger reveal
effects.mechanism: E20 + per-sibling delay

effects.name: image accordion
effects.mechanism: flex-grow transition on hover/focus + overlay fade

params.growNote: grow duration not measured on source; theme-wide 0.3–0.4s used

effects.name: highlight-title reveal
effects.mechanism: background-size sweep on highlight span when revealed
effects.reason: keyframes confirmed on source, duration not measurable (one-shot); 0.6s chosen, tunable in ?debug

effects.name: typed text rotator
effects.mechanism: grapheme-safe typing loop (Intl.Segmenter th) — line-level fallback without Segmenter
effects.reason: word-change delay 2500ms measured; per-character cadence not serialized on source — 60ms/grapheme chosen, tunable

effects.name: counter count-up
effects.mechanism: rAF tween of textContent on first view

effects.name: image/text marquee
effects.mechanism: duplicated track, linear translateX loop, px/s honored at runtime

effects.name: swap-button hover
effects.mechanism: label swap + color crossfade, no geometric movement

effects.name: image pan on hover
effects.mechanism: inner placeholder pans vertically inside clipped frame while hovered
effects.reason: direction/trigger measured; pan speed not measured on source — 6s full-travel chosen, tunable

effects.name: featured-box hover state
effects.mechanism: color/background swap on hover, no movement

effects.name: global micro-transitions
effects.mechanism: shared 0.3s/0.4s ease transition tokens

effects.name: conveyor media carousel
effects.mechanism: hand-written continuous linear track (no Swiper); one step per 10.5s

effects.name: before/after slider
effects.mechanism: clip-path inset + click/drag/keyboard divider

effects.name: ambient background drift
effects.mechanism: sine x/y drift ±5% on shared rAF

effects.name: header absolute
effects.mechanism: absolute header scrolls away; no hide/show because source page does not use it

effects.name: timed popup modal
effects.mechanism: dialog opens after delay; close button; ESC closes
effects.reason: trigger value 200 serialized without units on source — 20s chosen, tunable in ?debug

effects.name: offcanvas menu
effects.mechanism: hamburger toggles fixed side panel
